frozen_before: any registry count, job-post count, pain evidence or segment score was collected in this lane
note: Weights and anchors fixed before scoring. Do not edit after scoring starts; if they change, add a new version and keep this one. Every sub-score is 1-5 where 5 is ALWAYS the better outcome for a VP beachhead (so risk, difficulty and cycle length are scored inversely).
primary_score: weighted sum of sub-scores (weights sum to 100) -> range 100-500, reported /5

pain_intensity.5: documented, money-denominated loss per failed/late contact (>Rs 500 per event) AND a documented high failure rate (>=20% of contacts)
pain_intensity.3: documented operational pain (slow response, attrition, missed calls) but money per event small or unquantified

current_spend.5: segment-wide telecalling/contact-centre spend clearly > Rs 3,000 Cr/yr, typical mid-market buyer runs >= 25 seats
current_spend.3: Rs 500-3,000 Cr/yr segment-wide or typical buyer 5-25 seats
current_spend.1: < Rs 500 Cr/yr or buyer typically has 0-2 seats

call_volume.5: typical in-reach buyer places > 50,000 connected minutes/month of repetitive calls

regulatory_safety.5: mainly service/transactional calls to existing customers (1600/1601 or registered 10-digit service), no sector conduct overlay
regulatory_safety.3: consented pre-sales follow-up (inquiry within the TRAI relationship window) or service calls with a sector overlay (RBI/IRDAI)
regulatory_safety.1: depends on cold promotional calls or on sector conduct rules with reputational/enforcement exposure (e.g. recovery)

integration_ease.5: trigger + outcome can flow via CSV/webhook or a standard platform with public APIs (Shopify, Shiprocket, LeadSquared, Zoho)
integration_ease.3: needs a CRM/LMS integration per customer or a custom data push
integration_ease.1: core banking/LOS/policy-admin integration, infosec audit, on-prem or data-localisation demands

sales_cycle_short.5: founder/ops head decides, pilot in < 4 weeks

willingness_ability_to_pay.5: high value per outcome (> Rs 1,000), healthy margins, pays on time, existing paid line item for calling
willingness_ability_to_pay.3: moderate value per outcome (Rs 100-1,000) or price-sensitive but paying
willingness_ability_to_pay.1: thin margins / value per outcome < Rs 50 / slow payers

post_sales_share.5: >= 75% of the segment's call minutes are post-sales/service to existing customers

sensitivity_checks_declared_in_advance: S1: the H3 prediction's multiplicative form: (pain x spend x ease) / regulatory_risk, where ease = mean(integration_ease, sales_cycle_short) and regulatory_risk = 6 - regulatory_safety
S2: 10,000 random weight vectors drawn from Dirichlet(alpha = 4 x fixed weights / 100 x 8) around the fixed weights; report P(rank in top 3) per segment
S3: drop the regulatory weight to 0 (what if lane l1 is wrong in our favour)
S4: double the regulatory weight (what if enforcement tightens)
unweighted_flags_recorded_but_not_scored: realism_leverage: does human-likeness plausibly change the outcome in this segment (H5 input)
incumbent_density: how many voice-AI vendors already sell into it (H4 input)
excluded_large_firms: the in-house giants removed from 'in reach'
